---
title: "project"
---

Use the `project` command for GitHub Project-related setup that is independent of agent configuration.

## Install the GitHub Projects skill

```bash
setupmjr project --gh-skill
```

This installs `github-projects` from `MiguelRodo/github-projects-skill` for universal agents at user scope. It is equivalent to:

```bash
gh skill install MiguelRodo/github-projects-skill github-projects --agent universal --scope user --force --pin main
```

The command installs the shared skill only. Repository-specific Project onboarding and `.projects` configuration remain separate concerns.
